ad113781e76399a428807dd2cdd760baacec9642.notes: A slim GIS layer, not a full standard-columns register: only ID, Site_Name, Gross_Area_HA and coordinates are present -- no ownership/planning/dwellings/dates/plan-url fields to map. 79b285ed3608e0558d3fa1259f6f0c6d7e0f4109.notes: A GeoServer WFS CSV export of the 2017 standard's field names, lowercased and truncated to 10 characters, with an underscore+digit suffix on collisions ('permission'/'permissi_1' for PermissionType/PermissionDate). 'coordinate' says the row's CRS ('OSGB36') and geox/geoy are real BNG metres, mapped to easting/northing. Two other columns also carry a net-dwellings figure -- 'netdwellin' duplicates 'minnetdwel' in every sample row and 'site_id_2' duplicates part of 'siterefere' as a bare number -- both left unmapped as redundant. 'developmen' (DevelopmentDescription) is a fuller free-text field than 'notes' in places, but 'notes' is kept for the schema's notes column to match how every other source in this family with both fields is mapped.
